CRITICAL OUTPUT RULE FOR carousel_slides:

The value of "carousel_slides" must be a single string containing JSON object items.

Correct:
"carousel_slides":"{\"title\":\"First title\",\"text\":\"First text\"},{\"title\":\"Second title\",\"text\":\"Second text\"}"

Never use:
Slide 1
Title:
Text:

Never use markdown.
Never use line breaks inside carousel_slides.
Never add square brackets inside carousel_slides.
Never return carousel_slides as an array.
